heading: Precision Oxygen Therapeutics
intent: For immediate, controlled microvascular and tissue-level oxygenation while endogenous erythropoiesis recovers.
profile: A donor-independent oxygen carrier with long shelf life at room temperature, designed to be endotoxin-free and red-cell-antigen-free, with compatibility across all blood types. For all species.
evidenceNote: Development objectives. Species-specific dosing, safety and efficacy require independent evidence.
